FAQ

Common questions

What is CEFFLO?
CEFFLO is a delivery management platform for merchants. It gives you a dashboard to dispatch orders, manage your own riders, and give customers live tracking — without relying on a third-party marketplace.
How is CEFFLO different from Grab, foodpanda, or Lalamove?
Grab and foodpanda take a commission on every order and own your customer database — not you. Lalamove charges per delivery trip with no ordering system at all. CEFFLO gives you your own dashboard, your own riders, your own customer database, and a flat monthly fee — so you keep more of every sale as margin.
Do I need my own riders to use CEFFLO?
Yes — CEFFLO is built around your own rider fleet, whether that's one part-time rider or a team of twenty. The Rider app helps them manage pickups and routes; your dashboard helps you manage them.
Can my customers track their orders?
Yes. Every order comes with a live tracking link and dedicated Customer app experience — from "Picked Up" through "On The Way" to "Delivered," plus direct chat with the assigned rider.
Is there a setup fee?
No setup fee on any plan. CEFFLO Go is free to start, and CEFFLO Plus comes with a 14-day free trial before you're charged.
What happens after my free trial ends?
You'll be notified before your trial ends. If you don't upgrade, your account automatically continues on CEFFLO Go — you won't be charged without confirming first.
